author: NimBus Adapter Kit
name: NimBus adapter (Worker / Container App)
description: A NimBus adapter that connects one external system (Dataverse, Business Central, F&O, ...) to a NimBus event bus: typed failures, retry rules, circuit breaker, inbox deduplication, tests, provisioner, Aspire AppHost, Bicep and an Azure DevOps pipeline.

SystemName.description: PascalCase name of the external system, for example BusinessCentral, Dataverse or FinanceOperations. It names the endpoint (BusinessCentralEndpoint), the client (IBusinessCentralClient) and the exception types.

Inbox.description: Deduplicate redeliveries with the NimBus SQL Server inbox (needs a SQL database for the integration platform).

NimBusVersion.description: The Akaule.NimBus.* package version. Match the NimBus version your Resolver and WebApp run.
